title: SharePoint: Organization-wide page templates
description: We are introducing organization-wide page templates in SharePoint, enabling organizations to provide reusable, approved starting points for page creation across sites within a tenant. Managed centrally in the SharePoint site associated with your organization's brand center, these templates help authors reduce repetitive setup and create pages with consistent content.
